title: HealthObservation
description: One time-bounded observation of an engine instance's, a provider's or a provider capability's operational health (ADR-SHARED-007 §37, ADR-BCP-006 SS18-22, SS72-73). Health is an observation, not a fact: it is valid only from observed_at until expires_at. A consumer that holds no observation, or only an expired one, treats the subject's health as UNKNOWN. How UNKNOWN affects eligibility is health-policy.yaml's rule. Health stays separate from provider lifecycle.

observed_at.description: When the observation was made, not when it was recorded. An observation dated after now is not yet current, and counts as UNKNOWN.

expires_at.description: After this instant the observation says nothing, and the subject's health is UNKNOWN until a newer one arrives. Must be later than observed_at.

reasons.description: Registered codes explaining the status. Empty only for HEALTHY.

healthSubject.description: What was observed, at one of the three levels ADR-BCP-006 SS73 keeps apart: an engine instance, a provider, or one capability on a provider (SS72). A level is never inferred from another.
